name: Typeform Invoice PDF
description: Build a two-item invoice from a completed Typeform response, generate its PDF with APITemplate.io and retain the complete PDF and generation response.
requirements: Typeform Connection with access to the configured form and webhook registration
APITemplate.io API key and a PDF template accepting the invoice fields
Six required form answers in the documented order and configured issuer/document fields
A downloadable HTTPS PDF URL on the configured host; Open Flow download at most 1 MiB
